# CreditWise — Loan Approval Prediction

A machine learning-based loan approval prediction system that evaluates applicant information and predicts whether a loan application is likely to be **approved or rejected**.

## 🚀 Overview

CreditWise uses multiple classification algorithms to analyze loan application data and compare their prediction performance.

### Machine Learning Models
- **Logistic Regression**
- **K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)**
- **Naive Bayes**

The models are trained on historical loan application data and used to predict approval outcomes for new applicants.

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

- Python
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Scikit-learn
- Matplotlib / Seaborn
- Jupyter Notebook

## 🔄 Workflow

```text
Dataset
   ↓
Data Preprocessing
   ↓
Feature Selection & Encoding
   ↓
Train-Test Split
   ↓
Model Training
   ↓
Logistic Regression | KNN | Naive Bayes
   ↓
Model Evaluation
   ↓
Loan Approval Prediction
```

## 📊 Models Compared

| Model | Type |
|---|---|
| Logistic Regression | Linear Classification |
| KNN | Distance-Based Classification |
| Naive Bayes | Probabilistic Classification |

The models can be evaluated using metrics such as **accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and confusion matrix**.

## 🎯 Goal

The goal of CreditWise is to demonstrate how machine learning classification techniques can be applied to a real-world **credit/loan approval problem** and how different algorithms perform on the same dataset.

> **Note:** This project is for educational and experimental purposes and should not be used as the sole basis for real-world financial or lending decisions.
